plain: Sent away, allowed to leave, or removed from a job or post

webster.text: Sent away; permitted to depart; removed from office or employment.

example.quote: It gives me pain to dwell on topics of this kind, and I wish they might be dismissed.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
